newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Mortgage Agency $111 mln repriced, yields cut.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Mortgage Agency $111 mln repriced, yields cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said Tuesday it repriced New York Mortgage Agency's $111 million bond deal, lowering yields in some maturities but leaving the top yield in 2028 unchanged at 5.85 percent.
